questions.question: Which description fits the **MedicinalProductIngredient** resource?
options: An ingredient of a manufactured item or pharmaceutical product.
Describe the undesirable effects of the medicinal product.
A medicinal product in a container or package.
This resource is defined as a single unit of a linear amino acid sequence, or a combination of subunits that are either covalently linked or have a defined invariant stoichiometric relationship.
questions.explanation: **MedicinalProductIngredient**: An ingredient of a manufactured item or pharmaceutical product. The other descriptions belong to **MedicinalProductUndesirableEffect**, **MedicinalProductPackaged**, **SubstanceProtein**.

questions.question: Which resource matches this definition from the specification? “An ingredient of a manufactured item or pharmaceutical product.”
questions.explanation: This is the definition of **MedicinalProductIngredient** (Specialized › Medication Definition).

questions.question: Where does **MedicinalProductIngredient** sit in the FHIR R4 resource list?
questions.explanation: **MedicinalProductIngredient** is in **Specialized › Medication Definition**: Detailed regulatory data about medicinal products and substances (authorisations, ingredients, packaging, interactions, side effects), used by regulators and drug databases rather than in everyday patient care.

questions.question: Which element is **required** (minimum cardinality 1) in every **MedicinalProductIngredient** instance?
questions.explanation: The required top-level elements of MedicinalProductIngredient are `role` (1..1). The other options have a minimum cardinality of 0, so they are optional.
